sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2021/03/PXD023249/20200904_FJ_LoneGram_Chitin_mannose.pdResult (SQLite; AnalysisDefinition StudyDefinition + Workflows tables read via HTTP range reads)

claims.evidence: 36 RAW files in PRIDE file list, each claimed exactly once; 3 pdResult files are search outputs, not annotated as assays.

claims.location: source name; characteristics[genotype]; characteristics[organism part]; characteristics[biological replicate]; factor value[*]
claims.value: WT/dGH19 x sup/cells x replicate 1-3 per carbon source
claims.evidence: StudyDefinition Samples factor in each pdResult maps Chitin_01-12 (mannose), 13-24 (chitin), 25-36 (shrimpshells) to e.g. 'WT sup 1', 'dGH19 cells 3'. Project names of the three pdResults give the carbon source.
PRIDE organism NEWT:43658; strain S4059 in title and Methods 4.1.
Paper section 2.7 and 4.4: wild type and GH19 chitinase deletion mutant; pdResult labels 'dGH19'.

Paper 4.4 states MMM with crystalline chitin; PRIDE description says crystalline chitin or mannose. Third set named 'shrimpshells' only in the pdResult file name; interpretation as natural shrimp shells is inferred.
Methods 4.4: culture supernatant acetone-precipitated; washed cell pellets lysed in guanidinium buffer.
PRIDE instrument MS:1001911; Methods 4.5 DD-MS2 top10, NCE 25. HCD inferred from Q Exactive + NCE (not named explicitly).
Search enzyme in Sequest HT node is Trypsin (KR, no P). Digestion also used LysC (1:50, 4 h) before trypsin; SDRF contract allows a single cleavage agent, so Lys-C is not encoded.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance]; comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Workflows table: Sequest HT node PeptideTolerance 10 ppm, FragmentTolerance 0.02 Da in all three pdResults (a second, non-search node holds 20 ppm/0.5 Da; ignored).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl protein N-term, Met-loss, Met-loss+Acetyl variable
claims.evidence: Sequest HT node static/dynamic modification parameters. Paper/PRIDE also state Deamidation (N,Q) but it is not set in the deposited workflows; not encoded.
Lysis buffer 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM CAA (PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol, Methods 4.4).
